title: 🔎 Search notes by every word of the query
description:
Closes #11

## Summary

Adds `GET /notes/search?q=` and `DELETE /notes/:id`. A note matches a search when its title or body contains **every** word of the query.

```diff
-  return [...notes.values()]
+  return [...notes.values()].sort((left, right) => right.updatedAt - left.updatedAt)
```

- [x] Tests for the matching rule
- [ ] Pagination

+import { expect, test } from 'bun:test'
+
+import { searchNotes } from '../search.ts'
+import { saveNote } from '../store.ts'
+
+test('finds a note only when every word matches', () => {
+  saveNote({ id: 'a', title: 'Groceries', body: 'milk and eggs', updatedAt: 1 })
+  saveNote({ id: 'b', title: 'Work', body: 'eggs for the team breakfast', updatedAt: 2 })
+
+  expect(searchNotes('milk eggs').map(note => note.id)).toEqual(['a'])
+})
+
+test('returns nothing for a blank query', () => {
+  expect(searchNotes('   ')).toEqual([])
+})

+import { listNotes } from './store.ts'
+import type { Note } from './store.ts'
+
+export function searchNotes(query: string): Note[] {
+  const words = query.toLowerCase().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean)
+  if (words.length === 0) return []
+
+  return listNotes().filter(note => {
+    const text = `${note.title} ${note.body}`.toLowerCase()
+    return words.every(word => text.includes(word))
+  })
+}

analysis.overallSummary: Adds **search** and **delete** to the notes API. Search lowercases the query and keeps the notes that contain every word. `listNotes` now returns the newest note first, which also changes the order of `GET /notes`. The rest is a test file, a removed formatter, and the README moving to `README.markdown`.

groups.label: Search by every word
groups.summary: `searchNotes` splits the query on whitespace and keeps a note when its title and body together contain each word. A blank query returns no notes rather than all of them.

fileNotes.text: Pins the every-word rule and the blank query.

lineNotes.text: A blank query returns `[]`, not every note.
Title and body are joined with a space, so a word cannot match across the boundary.

groups.label: New search and delete routes
groups.summary: `handle` answers `GET /notes/search?q=` before the `/notes/:id` match, and adds `DELETE /notes/:id`, which answers 404 for an unknown id.

lineNotes.text: The search route must come before the `/notes/:id` match; `search` would otherwise match `\w+` as an id.
`decodeURIComponent` throws on a malformed escape such as `%E0`.

groups.label: Newest note first
groups.summary: `listNotes` sorts by `updatedAt`, newest first, and `deleteNote` is new. Every caller of `listNotes` sees the new order, including `GET /notes`.

fileNotes.text: The sort changes the response of an existing endpoint.
